intlaid.title: William & Mary - Financial Aid for International Applicants

test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT scores are completely optional; W&M does not require them. Forty percent of the Class of 2029 applied test-optional.

requirements.notes: Checklist lists the Common App, high school transcript, essay and recommendation letters; the exact number of teacher recommendations and supplemental essays was not stated on the pages read. $75 non-refundable fee with a fee-waiver request option. Supplemental materials (transcripts, scores, recommendations) may arrive after the deadline.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I (binding)
deadlines.notes: Decision early December (no exact date published); enrollment deposit due Jan 5; FAFSA and CSS Profile priority Nov 15, final Dec 12.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II (binding)
deadlines.notes: Decision early February (no exact date published); enrollment deposit due Feb 15; FAFSA and CSS Profile priority Jan 15, final Mar 1.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Notification 'by Apr. 1'; enrollment deposit due May 1; FAFSA and CSS Profile priority Feb 1, final Mar 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Strongly recommended if English is not your native language and your schooling in the past four years or more was in another language; applicants who spoke another language at home should also strongly consider it. Duolingo is accepted when TOEFL/IELTS are not accessible.

english.notes: 'Generally' looking for 100 on tests taken on or before January 20, 2026; not a hard minimum. Single sitting or MyBest.
'Generally' 5 on the 1-6 scale for tests taken on or after January 21, 2026; not a hard minimum.
Overall band 7 or above on the Academic test; not a hard minimum.
Accepted for applicants without access to TOEFL iBT or IELTS; no score is published.

aid.notes: The international page states that W&M generally does not have scholarships or loan funds for undergraduate international students who are citizens of other countries.
